backend/main.mo: Defines storage mixin and two public types for render order rules and Genesis craft previews.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence report linking features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists short summaries for many frontend files describing UI behavior, logic, and features.
frontend/index.css: Sets Tailwind base layers and theme CSS variables for light and dark modes with global styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component defining types, lazy-loaded pages, state logic, project validation, and persistence integration.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Provides a reusable destructive-action confirmation dialog using the confirm store and alert-dialog UI components.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Create: Modal dialog for creating a new project with fields for name, symbol, size, and pixel art mode.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/NewPro: Clickable tile that starts the process of creating a new project.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Projec: Dialog for editing a project's name, symbol, collection size, and pixel art mode with validation.
Displays project info in a tile with open, settings, and delete actions and animated hover effects.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a minimalist footer with copyright text, heart icon, and caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Navigation header with responsive menus, project info, and save-status indicator supporting multiple views.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Simple hover/focus tooltip component showing contextual text above the target element.
frontend/src/components/icons/index.tsx: Exports lightweight inline React SVG icon components to replace lucide-react imports.
frontend/src/components/MotionIconButton: Button component with motion-based hover/active effects and accessibility-focused styling.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: Dialog component explaining how to obtain and use a Pinata JWT token with step-by-step instructions and warnings.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: Displays a small status text showing saving, saved, or idle states without causing layout shift.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: Provides lock, unlock, and IPFS upload controls for a project, handling upload flow, progress, and state updates.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Toggle buttons to switch between compact and grid view modes in the vault.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Implements a zustand-based confirmation modal store and a hook that returns a promise-based destructive confirmation helper.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and utilities for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Debounced hook that validates a Pinata JWT key and returns status and messages based on validation results.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file noting that backend queries are unnecessary due to localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, motion settings, accessibility tweaks, and custom utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: React component for generating NFT previews, managing trait selection, uploads, and custom token deletion within the project builder.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main dashboard with project tiles and handles creating, updating, opening, and deleting projects via dialogs and callbacks.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Generates live NFT previews by merging trait layers on a canvas, including randomization, rule validation, and pixel mode rendering.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Provides an interface for adjusting and normalizing trait rarity weights within layers, with automatic initialization and validation.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Manages creation, editing, duplication, and deletion of trait compatibility rules, including modal workflows and validation.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Allows editing project settings such as metadata format, blockchain, creators, and Pinata keys with validation and synchronized updates.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Complex NFT vault page handling generation, filtering, sorting, view modes, worker communication, and ZIP creation.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: Editor UI for managing layers and traits, including adding, deleting, renaming, and reordering.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Uploads generated NFT images and metadata to Pinata IPFS with progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Builds NFT metadata objects for preview and export across Ethereum, Solana, and ICP formats.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Handles localStorage saving/loading of the project with simple last-write-wins semantics and cleanup of legacy data.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Pinata API helpers for validating keys and uploading files, JSON, and directories to IPFS.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines message types and data structures for communication between the UI and the NFT generator worker, including trait, layer, rule, and NFT result formats.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Provides an async helper that yields control to the browser event loop to keep the UI responsive during heavy operations.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Implements the NFT generation worker handling trait selection, rule validation, DNA creation, optional OffscreenCanvas compositing, and metadata creation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, spacing, screens, typography, and animations for the frontend.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, requirements, and goals focused on bundle-size reduction and adding lightweight UI motion effects.
